answer: A voting key is issued only after the operator leases one numbered municipal orchard row for one season, keeps a sealed sap-flow logger on one marked tree in that grove, and locks 3,050 units for 28 days. Weekly time-lapse frames from the garden path and the logger's signed readings are posted; a reused row, cloned logger, or shared payment rail burns the bond. An honest grower pays one assessment and parks 3,050 units. Raising 125 sockpuppets needs 125 distinct rows and 381,250 units left idle. Tags planted on a dune are rejected when the sap-flow curve fails to match the published tree.
